exposure: serotype-specific anti-capsular polysaccharide (CPS) immunoglobulin G concentrations near birth
outcome: infant Group B Streptococcus (GBS) disease risk
cohort: The study included 643 infant cases with Group B Streptococcus (GBS) disease and 2801 infant controls without GBS disease.
finding: Antibody concentrations were significantly lower in infants with GBS disease compared to controls, and 80% serotype-specific protective thresholds varied by serotype and age at onset, being notably lower for late-onset disease (0.02 to 0.14 mcg/mL) than early-onset disease (0.52 to 2.49 mcg/mL).
